tableRows: Easy AppointmentsDocumented self-hosted appointment plugin marketed for clinics and health practices (plugin version 4.0.3). WordPress admin screens cover locations, services, workers, an appointments list, a customer list, custom form fields, and CSV export. The v4.0.3 readme changelog records a repeat-appointment feature (3.12.13). A three-times-a-week chair slot is a repeating booking you create; a service name such as dialysis is a label you configure. Neither is a documented default. Transport-needs, insurance, or Medicare questions are custom fields you add (textarea, select, or input); they are not documented defaults. A booking is not a medical record. The appointments list can show a repeating cadence even when no health-history field exists. Emails can include those custom fields. An optional GDPR setting can auto-remove customer data older than six months; that is not a default purge. Google Calendar, SMS, and payments are Pro. Google reCAPTCHA is optional.
